design: Capture metadata and LABHK for every listed NOIW FITS. Bind all requests within a file by ETag, exact byte intervals, FITS extent and file length. Deduplicate identical monitor samples by MJD, refusing conflicting values. Compare signed MCT samples with the GAIN monitor series; evaluate paired science dispersion when subtracting the minimum, median and maximum of the NOIW MCT readings as hypothetical constant offsets. Separate days and different illumination commands prohibit claiming a validated dark transfer or photon calibration; do not infer a matched optical monitor zero.
